systems.platform: smartphone application developed in-house by ANRPTS engineers
systems.owner: Agence nationale du registre des populations et des titres sécurisés (ANRPTS)
systems.tiers: citizen-facing application in the field of 'état civil numérique', making digitised personal documents available to citizens wherever they are; won the government-solutions category at the Africa T-Awards 2026 in Dakar, announced 9 April 2026

note: The communiqué describes Houwiyeti as a smartphone application bringing administrative services and digitised personal documents to citizens; it does not describe any office registering a birth or death.
